words.en: A loser is someone who is not successful in a particular situation or who does not achieve what they set out to do.

words.ex: Mister Brown is my teacher.
words.ex_cn: 布朗先生是我的老师。
words.en: A title used before a man's name or position to address or refer to him politely.

words.ex: The newcomer joined our class last week.
words.ex_cn: 这个新来的人上周加入了我们的班级。
words.en: A newcomer is a person who has recently arrived in a place or started an activity.

words.tr: n. 新闻广播员；新闻播音员
words.ex: The newscaster reported the weather today.
words.ex_cn: 新闻主播今天报道了天气。
words.en: A newscaster is a person who reads the news on television or radio.

words.ex: The nobleman lived in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 这位贵族住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A nobleman is a man who belongs to the noble class in a society, especially in the past.

words.ex: The nun walks to the church every morning.
words.ex_cn: 修女每天早上步行去教堂。
words.en: A nun is a member of a female religious community, typically one living under vows of poverty, chastity, and obedience.

words.ex: The dogs had three offspring last spring.
words.ex_cn: 这些狗去年春天生了三只幼崽。
words.en: Someone's offspring are their children.

words.tr: n. 局外人；无取胜希望者；
words.ex: He felt like an outsider at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在聚会上感觉像个局外人。
words.en: An outsider is someone who does not belong to a particular group or organization.

words.ex: He is a physicist who studies stars.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位研究恒星的物理学家。
words.en: A physicist is a scientist who specializes in the field of physics, which is the study of matter, energy, and the fundamental forces of nature.

words.tr: n. 促进者；发起者；倡导者；支持者
words.ex: He is a promoter of healthy eating.
words.ex_cn: 他是健康饮食的倡导者。
words.en: A promoter is a person or organization that helps to organize and finance an event, such as a concert or sports match.

words.tr: n. 保护者；保护装置；保护器； 摄政王、护国公
words.ex: The knight is the protector of the village.
words.ex_cn: 骑士是村庄的保护者。
words.en: A protector is someone or something that protects a person or thing from harm or damage.

words.tr: n. 新教徒（16世纪脱离罗马天主教的基督教徒）
words.ex: He is a protestant who goes to church every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名新教徒，每周日都去教堂。
words.en: A Protestant is a member or follower of any of the Western Christian churches that are separate from the Roman Catholic Church and follow the principles of the Reformation, including the Baptist, Presbyterian, and Lutheran churches.

words.ex: The senator speaks to the people every week.
words.ex_cn: 这位参议员每周都对人民讲话。
words.en: A senator is a member of a senate, which is a governing body in many countries, especially in the United States.

words.ex: The sender wrote his address on the envelope.
words.ex_cn: 寄件人在信封上写了地址。
words.en: A sender is someone who sends something to someone else.

words.tr:
adj. 社会主义的
n. 社会主义者
words.ex: He is a socialist who believes in equal rights.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位相信平等权利的社会主义者。
words.en: A socialist is someone who believes in socialism, which is a political and economic theory advocating that the means of production, distribution, and exchange should be owned or regulated by the community as a whole.

words.ex: The old man is a good storyteller.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人是个出色的故事讲述者。
words.en: A storyteller is someone who tells or writes stories.

words.ex: He calls her sweetheart every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都叫她亲爱的。
words.en: A sweetheart is a person with whom one is in love or has a romantic relationship.

words.ex: The taxpayer paid his taxes on time.
words.ex_cn: 纳税人按时缴税了。
words.en: A taxpayer is a person or organization that pays taxes to the government.

words.ex: The technician fixed the broken machine.
words.ex_cn: 技术员修好了坏掉的机器。
words.en: A technician is a worker trained with special skills, especially in science or engineering.

words.ex: The tenant pays rent every month.
words.ex_cn: 房客每个月支付租金。
words.en: A tenant is a person who rents land or property from a landlord.

words.ex: The translator helped him understand the French book.
words.ex_cn: 这位翻译员帮他理解了这本法语书。
words.en: A translator is a person whose job is translating writing or speech from one language to another.

words.ex: The viewer watched the movie on TV.
words.ex_cn: 观看者在电视上看了这部电影。
words.en: A viewer is someone who watches something, especially television.

words.ex: The forest is a virgin land, untouched by humans.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林是未开发的土地，从未被人类触及过。
words.en: A virgin is someone who has never had sexual intercourse. It can also describe something that is in its original pure or natural condition and has not been touched or changed by people.

words.tr: n. 投票者；选民；选举人
words.ex: The voter cast his ballot in the election.
words.ex_cn: 这位选民在选举中投了票。
words.en: A voter is a person who votes or has the right to vote in an election.

words.tr: n. 看守人；警卫；巡夜者
words.ex: The watchman patrolled the perimeter of the factory.
words.ex_cn: 看守人在工厂周围巡逻。
words.en: A watchman is a person whose job is to guard a building or area, especially at night.

words.ex: The workman fixed the roof with tools.
words.ex_cn: 工人用工具修好了屋顶。
words.en: A workman is a man who works with his hands, especially in a skilled job.

words.ex: He uses aluminum foil to wrap the food.
words.ex_cn: 他用铝箔纸包食物。
words.en: A light, silvery metal that is used especially for making cooking equipment and aircraft parts.

words.ex: He sits in the armchair and reads the newspaper.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在扶手椅上读报纸。
words.en: An armchair is a comfortable chair with sides that support your arms.

words.tr: n. 有价值的人或物；长处；
words.ex: He is an asset to the team because he works hard.
words.ex_cn: 他是个有价值的人，因为他工作努力。
words.en: An asset is something valuable that an individual, corporation, or country owns or controls with the expectation that it will provide a future benefit.

words.tr: n. 拍打器；搅拌器；助猎者；驱猎物者
words.ex: He uses a beater to mix the eggs.
words.ex_cn: 他用搅拌器搅拌鸡蛋。
words.en: A beater is a tool used for beating, such as an egg beater, or a person who beats something or someone.

words.ex: She sweeps the floor with a broom.
words.ex_cn: 她用扫帚扫地。
words.en: A broom is a cleaning tool consisting of usually stiff fibers attached to, and roughly parallel to, a cylindrical handle, the broomstick. It is thus a variety of brush with a long handle.

words.ex: He uses a calculator to add numbers.
words.ex_cn: 他用计算器来加数字。
words.en: A calculator is a small electronic device that you use for doing mathematical calculations.

words.tr:
n. 大炮；火炮
v. 猛撞；碰撞
words.ex: The soldiers fired the cannon at the enemy.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们向敌人开炮。
words.en: A cannon is a large, heavy piece of artillery which was used in wars to fire heavy metal balls or shells.

words.ex: He plays the cello every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上拉大提琴。
words.en: A cello is a large stringed instrument of the violin family, tuned an octave below the viola.

words.ex: He received a certificate for completing the course.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了课程后获得了证书。
words.en: A certificate is an official document attesting a fact, in particular.

words.ex: Wheat is a basic commodity in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 小麦在许多国家是一种基本商品。
words.en: A commodity is something that is bought and sold.

words.ex: He used a compass to find north.
words.ex_cn: 他用指南针找北方。
words.en: A compass is an instrument that you use for finding directions. It has a dial and a magnetic needle that always points to the north.

words.ex: He bought a condom at the store.
words.ex_cn: 他在商店买了一个安全套。
words.en: A condom is a thin rubber sheath worn on a man's penis during sexual intercourse as a contraceptive or as a protection against infection.

words.tr:
v. （使）突然移动；快速投掷；
n. 镖；
words.ex: The cat darted across the room.
words.ex_cn: 猫突然冲过房间。
words.en: A dart is a small, narrow object with a sharp point which can be thrown or shot. It can also mean to move suddenly and quickly in a particular direction.

words.ex: He found a dime on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 他在地上找到一枚一角硬币。
words.en: A dime is a coin worth ten cents, one tenth of a United States dollar.

words.ex: Children laughed as the firework lit up the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们看着焰火点亮夜空，哈哈大笑。
words.en: A firework is a small device that is lit to produce a display of light, noise, and smoke, often used in celebrations.

words.ex: The boy found a fossil in the rock.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在岩石中发现了一块化石。
words.en: A fossil is the remains or impression of a prehistoric organism preserved in petrified form or as a mold or cast in rock.

words.ex: The car's headlight is broken.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的前大灯坏了。
words.en: A headlight is a powerful light at the front of a vehicle, used for illuminating the road ahead.

words.ex: He inherited his family's heritage.
words.ex_cn: 他继承了家族的遗产。
words.en: Heritage refers to the traditions, achievements, beliefs, etc., that are part of the history of a group or nation.

words.tr: n. 持有者；拥有者；支架
words.ex: The holder of the ticket won a prize.
words.ex_cn: 票的持有者中了奖。
words.en: A holder is a person or thing that holds something.

words.ex: He received his father's watch as an inheritance.
words.ex_cn: 他收到了父亲留给他的手表作为遗产。
words.en: Inheritance is money or property which you receive from someone who has died.

words.tr: n. 废旧杂物；无价值的东西；
words.ex: He cleaned up the junk in his garage.
words.ex_cn: 他清理了车库里那些废旧杂物。
words.en: Old or discarded articles that are considered useless or of little value.

words.ex: He bought a repair kit for his bike.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一套自行车维修工具。
words.en: A kit is a group of items that are kept together, often in the same container, because they are all used for similar purposes.

words.ex: The clever boy solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个聪明的男孩很快解决了这道数学题。
words.en: Someone who is clever is intelligent and able to understand things easily or plan things well.

words.tr: n. 衬里；内衬；衬层； v. 排队；加衬里；“line”的现在分词；
words.ex: The coat has a soft lining for warmth.
words.ex_cn: 这件外套有柔软的衬里以保暖。
words.en: A lining is a layer of material that is fixed to the inside of something in order to protect it or make it warmer.

words.ex: The teacher used a loudspeaker to talk to the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师用扬声器对学生们讲话。
words.en: A loudspeaker is a piece of electronic equipment that makes sounds louder so that they can be heard at a greater distance.

words.ex: The factory buys lumber to make furniture.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂购买木材来制造家具。
words.en: Lumber refers to wood that has been processed into beams and planks, a stage in the process of wood production. It is also used to describe the action of moving in a slow, heavy, awkward way.

words.tr:
adj. 微型的；
n. 微型画；小型模型；
words.ex: He bought a miniature car for his collection.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的收藏买了一辆微型汽车。
words.en: A miniature is a very small detailed painting, often a portrait. It can also refer to a small-scale model or representation of something.

words.ex: He used the opener to open the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 他用开瓶器打开了瓶子。
words.en: An opener is a device or tool used to open something, such as a bottle or can, or the first event in a series of events.

words.ex: He pressed the pedal to speed up the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他踩下踏板让自行车加速。
words.en: A pedal is a lever that you press with your foot in order to control a vehicle or machine.

words.tr:
n. 栖枝；鲈鱼；
v. 栖息；处于（高处）；
words.ex: The bird sat on a perch near the tree.
words.ex_cn: 鸟停在树旁的一根栖枝上。
words.en: A perch is a branch or rod where a bird rests or a high position where someone or something is located. As a verb, it means to rest or be located in a high position.

words.ex: The old temple has four stone pillars.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的寺庙有四根石柱。
words.en: A pillar is a tall solid structure, which is usually used to support part of a building.

words.tr:
n. 塞子；
v. 插上；
words.ex: The sink is clogged because the plug is stuck.
words.ex_cn: 水槽堵塞了，因为塞子卡住了。
words.en: A plug is a small object at the end of a wire that is used for connecting a piece of electrical equipment to the main supply of electricity. It is also a piece of material that is used for blocking a hole.

words.tr:
n. 探测器；
v. 探查；
words.ex: The probe sent back photos from Mars.
words.ex_cn: 探测器从火星传回了照片。
words.en: If you probe into something, you ask questions or try to discover facts about it. A probe is also a long thin instrument that doctors and dentists use to examine parts of the body.

words.ex: The child laughed at the puppet on the stage.
words.ex_cn: 孩子笑了，看着舞台上那个木偶。
words.en: A puppet is a doll that you can move by pulling strings which are attached to it or by putting your hand inside its body and moving your fingers.

words.tr:
n. 架子；支架；齿条；破坏
v. 折磨；使痛苦；放在架上；累计（得分）
words.ex: He put the books on the rack.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在架子上。
words.en: A rack is a frame or shelf, usually with bars or hooks, that is used for holding things or for hanging things on. As a verb, to rack something means to cause great pain or suffering to someone.

words.ex: The radar shows a plane coming near.
words.ex_cn: 雷达显示一架飞机正在靠近。
words.en: A system for detecting the presence, direction, distance, and speed of aircraft, ships, and other objects, by sending out pulses of radio waves which are reflected off the object back to the source.

words.ex: He wound the fishing line onto the reel.
words.ex_cn: 他把鱼线绕在卷筒上。
words.en: A reel is a cylinder on which film, wire, thread, or other flexible materials can be wound. It can also refer to a lively Scottish or Irish dance, or to the act of staggering or lurching violently.

words.ex: The reproduction of rabbits is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 兔子的生殖速度很快。
words.en: The process of producing offspring or new individuals of the same species, or the act of making a copy of something.

words.ex: He threw the rubbish into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: Waste material; refuse or litter.

words.ex: He wrote a script for a short movie.
words.ex_cn: 他为一部短片写了剧本。
words.en: A script is the written form of a play, film, or broadcast. It includes the dialogue and stage directions.

words.ex: The searchlight swept across the sky, searching for enemy aircraft.
words.ex_cn: 探照灯在天空中扫过，搜寻敌机。
words.en: A searchlight is a powerful light that can be directed to shine in a particular direction, often used to find or illuminate something in the dark.

words.tr:
n. 屎；粪便；拉屎；胡扯
v. 拉屎；对…胡扯
int. 表示气愤或恼怒
words.ex: The dog left a pile of shit on the grass.
words.ex_cn: 狗在草地上拉了一堆屎。
words.en: Shit is a vulgar word for feces. It can also be used to express anger, frustration, or disappointment.

words.ex: He pressed the shutter to take a photo.
words.ex_cn: 他按下快门拍了一张照片。
words.en: A shutter is a device used to cover or uncover a window or a camera lens.

words.ex: The skyscraper is very tall and has many floors.
words.ex_cn: 这座摩天大楼非常高，有很多层。
words.en: A skyscraper is a very tall building that has many floors.

words.ex: He sat on a wooden stool.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在一个木凳上。
words.en: A stool is a seat without a back or arms, typically resting on three or four legs or on a single pedestal.

words.tr: n. 平板电脑；（刻有文字的）匾；
words.ex: He uses a tablet to read books.
words.ex_cn: 他用平板电脑读书。
words.en: A tablet is a small, flat computer that is controlled by touching the screen. It can also refer to a small, solid piece of medicine that you swallow.

words.tr:
n. 标签；标记；
v. 加标签于；
words.ex: The tag on the shirt says 'wash cold'.
words.ex_cn: 衬衫上的标签写着‘冷水洗涤’。
words.en: A tag is a small piece of card, cloth, or plastic which is attached to an object or person and has information about that object or person on it. A tag can also be a word or phrase that is used to describe or identify something, especially in a computer file or on a website.

words.ex: Add a teaspoon of sugar to the tea.
words.ex_cn: 给茶里加一茶匙糖。
words.en: A teaspoon is a small spoon that you use to put sugar into tea or coffee.

words.ex: He won a trophy for first place in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中获得第一名，赢得了一个奖杯。
words.en: A trophy is a prize, such as a gold or silver cup, that is given to the winner of a competition or race.

words.tr:
n. 天鹅绒；丝绒
adj. 天鹅绒的
words.ex: The chair has a soft velvet cover.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子有柔软的丝绒坐垫。
words.en: A soft fabric with a thick short pile on one side, used for clothing and upholstery.

words.tr:
n. 水彩画
adj. 水彩的
words.ex: He paints with watercolor on paper.
words.ex_cn: 他用水彩在纸上绘画。
words.en: A watercolor is a painting done with watercolors, or the paint used in such paintings.

words.tr:
n. 皱纹
v. 起皱纹；弄皱…
words.ex: He has a deep wrinkle on his forehead.
words.ex_cn: 他的额头上有一道深深的皱纹。
words.en: A wrinkle is a small line or fold in something, especially fabric or the skin.

chapters.name: Level 6 形容词 学问•宗教•艺术

words.tr: adj. 按字母顺序的；字母的；
words.ex: The names are listed in alphabetical order.
words.ex_cn: 这些名字是按字母顺序排列的。
words.en: In the order of the letters of the alphabet.

words.tr: adj. 建筑学的；建筑方面的；
words.ex: The book shows architectural drawings of old buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这本书展示了古老建筑的建筑图纸。
words.en: Relating to the art and science of designing and constructing buildings.

words.tr: adj. 两种语言的；用两种语言的；
words.ex: He is a bilingual student who speaks English and Spanish.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个会说英语和西班牙语的双语学生。
words.en: A bilingual person is someone who can speak two languages equally well.

words.tr:
adj. 幸福的；受祝福的；神圣的
v. 祝福；保佑；“bless”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: She is blessed with a kind heart.
words.ex_cn: 她拥有一颗善良的心。
words.en: Made holy; consecrated.

words.ex: The temple is a divine place.
words.ex_cn: 这座寺庙是神的圣地。
words.en: Something that is divine relates to a god or goddess.

words.ex: The company follows ethical practices in hiring.
words.ex_cn: 该公司在招聘中遵循伦理规范。
words.en: Relating to moral principles or the branch of knowledge dealing with these.

words.ex: The sentence has a grammatical error.
words.ex_cn: 这个句子有一个语法错误。
words.en: Relating to grammar or the rules of grammar.

words.tr: adj. 教育性的；有启发的；有益的
words.ex: The movie is instructive for children.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影对孩子们很有教育意义。
words.en: Providing useful or interesting information or knowledge.

words.ex: She wrote a poetic letter to her friend.
words.ex_cn: 她给朋友写了一封诗意的信。
words.en: Something that is poetic is very beautiful and expresses emotions in a sensitive or moving way.

words.tr:
adj. 学龄前的；入学前的；
n. 幼儿园；幼稚园；
words.ex: He attends a preschool program every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上参加学龄前课程。
words.en: A school for children who are too young to attend kindergarten, typically for those aged between three and five.

words.ex: The theatrical lighting made the stage look magical.
words.ex_cn: 剧场的灯光让舞台显得神奇。
words.en: Theatrical means relating to the theatre or to the performance of plays. It can also describe behaviour that is exaggerated and intended to attract attention.

chapters.name: Level 6 形容词 感情•感觉

words.tr: adj. 讨厌的； v. “annoy”的现在分词；
words.ex: The loud noise is annoying.
words.ex_cn: 这噪音很讨厌。
words.en: Something that is annoying makes you feel fairly angry and impatient.

words.tr: v. 组成；创作；“compose”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The team is composed of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名队员组成。
words.en: If someone is composed, they are calm and able to control their feelings.

words.tr:
adj. 怯懦的；胆小的
adv. 胆怯地
words.ex: He was cowardly and ran away from the fight.
words.ex_cn: 他很懦弱，逃跑了。
words.en: If you describe someone as cowardly, you disapprove of them because they are easily frightened and avoid dangerous or difficult situations.

words.tr: adj. 令人抑郁的；令人沮丧的；令人消沉的； v. “depress”的现在分词；
words.ex: The rainy weather made the day feel depressing.
words.ex_cn: 阴雨的天气让这一天感觉令人抑郁。
words.en: Making someone feel very unhappy and without hope.

words.tr: adj. 令人失望的；令人扫兴的； v. “disappoint”的现在分词；
words.ex: The movie was disappointing.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影令人失望。
words.en: If something is disappointing, it is not as good as you hoped it would be.

words.tr: adj. 尴尬的；窘迫的； v. “embarrass”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt embarrassed when he tripped in front of everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他在大家面前绊倒时感到很尴尬。
words.en: If you are embarrassed, you feel shy or ashamed because of something that you have done or that has happened to you.

words.tr: adj. 有趣的；使人愉快的； v. 款待；“entertain”的现在分词；
words.ex: The clown gave an entertaining show.
words.ex_cn: 小丑表演了一场有趣的节目。
words.en: Providing amusement or enjoyment.

words.tr:
adj. 肮脏恶臭的；
v. 对…犯规；
words.ex: The foul smell came from the garbage bin.
words.ex_cn: 那股恶臭来自垃圾桶。
words.en: If you describe something as foul, you mean it is dirty and smells or tastes unpleasant. In sports, a foul is an act that is against the rules of the game.

words.tr: adj. 该死的（表达生气、愤怒、烦恼等）; adv. 该死地（表达生气、愤怒、烦恼等）; v. 性...
words.ex: I can't believe you're fucking late again!
words.ex_cn: 我真不敢相信你他妈的又迟到了！
words.en: Used to emphasize something, especially to express anger, annoyance, or contempt.

words.tr: adj. 不感兴趣的；不关心的；
words.ex: He was indifferent to the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他对这部电影不感兴趣。
words.en: If you accuse someone of being indifferent to something, you mean that they have a complete lack of interest in it.

words.tr: adj. 惹人生气的； v. “irritate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The loud noise is irritating.
words.ex_cn: 这噪音很惹人生气。
words.en: If you describe something as irritating, you mean that it keeps annoying you.

words.tr: adj. 令人放松的；轻松的； v. 放松；“relax”的现在分词；
words.ex: The music is relaxing.
words.ex_cn: 这音乐令人放松。
words.en: Making you feel less worried or tense; helping you to rest and become less stiff.

words.ex: The soup is too spicy for me.
words.ex_cn: 这汤对我来说太辣了。
words.en: Food that is spicy has a strong, hot flavor.

words.tr: adj. 令人吃惊的； v. “startle”的现在分词；
words.ex: The news was startling to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个消息让所有人都感到吃惊。
words.en: Something that is startling is so surprising, unexpected, or remarkable that it makes you feel slightly shocked.

words.ex: The soup is tasty and hot.
words.ex_cn: 这汤美味又热。
words.en: If you describe food as tasty, you mean that it has a pleasant and attractive flavour.

words.ex: He gave a vicious smile before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前露出一个恶毒的微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as vicious, you mean that they are violent and cruel, or that they are intended to cause someone great harm or suffering.

chapters.name: Level 6 形容词 形状•性质•外观

words.ex: This drink is alcoholic and not for children.
words.ex_cn: 这种饮料含酒精，不适合儿童饮用。
words.en: An alcoholic is someone who cannot stop drinking large amounts of alcohol, even when it is causing them serious health or personal problems.

words.tr: adj. 秃头的；不加修饰的；赤裸裸的
words.ex: The old man is bald.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人是秃头的。
words.en: Someone who is bald has little or no hair on the top of their head.

words.tr: n. 沸腾；煮沸； v. 煮沸；“boil”的现在分词； adj. 很热的；
words.ex: The boiling of water happens at 100 degrees Celsius.
words.ex_cn: 水的沸腾发生在100摄氏度。
words.en: The process of heating a liquid until it begins to turn into a gas, or the state of being very hot.

words.ex: The climatic changes affect the crops.
words.ex_cn: 气候的变化影响农作物。
words.en: Relating to the climate or weather conditions of a particular area.

words.ex: He went to the dental clinic for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 他去牙科诊所做检查。
words.en: Relating to the teeth or to the work of a dentist.

words.ex: The drunken man stumbled down the street.
words.ex_cn: 那个醉汉摇摇晃晃地走在街上。
words.en: Someone who is drunken is drunk or frequently gets drunk.

words.tr: v. 折叠；交叠；“fold”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is folding the paper into a crane.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把纸折叠成一只鹤。
words.en: 1. capable of being folded into a more compact shape. 2. the action of folding something.

words.ex: The picture is fuzzy and hard to see.
words.ex_cn: 这张图片很模糊，看不清楚。
words.en: Something that is fuzzy is unclear or indistinct, often because it is out of focus or because it is covered with a soft, fluffy material.

words.tr: adj. 能吃苦耐劳的；耐寒的；
words.ex: He is a hardy farmer who works in the field all day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个能吃苦耐劳的农民，整天在田里干活。
words.en: Someone who is hardy is strong and able to cope with difficult conditions.

words.ex: The village is in a hilly area near the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄位于靠近山地的多小山地区。
words.en: A hilly area has a lot of hills.

words.ex: The magnet has a magnetic force.
words.ex_cn: 这块磁铁有磁性。
words.en: If you describe something as magnetic, you mean that it is very attractive to people because it has unusual, powerful, and exciting qualities.

words.tr:
adj. 甜熟的；醇香的；柔和的；成熟的；沉醉的
v. （使）成熟；（使颜色）柔和；（使酒）更加醇香
words.ex: The apple became mellow after a few days.
words.ex_cn: 几天后，苹果变软了。
words.en: If someone mellows or if something mellows them, they become kinder or less extreme in their behavior, often as a result of becoming older or more experienced.

words.tr: v. 融化；熔化；消散；“melt”的现在分词； adj. 融化的；
words.ex: The ice is melting in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 冰在阳光下融化。
words.en: Becoming liquid, especially as a result of heating.

words.ex: The metallic spoon felt cold in her hand.
words.ex_cn: 金属勺子在她手中感觉很冷。
words.en: Metallic means relating to or resembling metal or metals.

words.ex: The milk looks milky and smooth.
words.ex_cn: 这牛奶看起来乳状且顺滑。
words.en: Resembling milk in color or consistency; containing milk.

words.tr:
n. 微型汽车；
adj. 微型的；迷你的；
words.ex: He drives a mini to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天开一辆微型汽车去上班。
words.en: Mini is used to describe something which is very small, especially a smaller version of something which is usually larger.

words.ex: The room was so noiseless that you could hear a pin drop.
words.ex_cn: 房间里非常安静，连一根针掉在地上都能听见。
words.en: Making little or no noise; silent.

words.ex: The table has an oval shape.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是椭圆形的。
words.en: An oval is a shape that is like a circle but is longer in one direction than the other.

words.ex: He took a photographic memory of the scene.
words.ex_cn: 他把场景记在了像照片一样的记忆里。
words.en: Relating to or used in photography; resembling a photograph in accuracy or detail.

words.tr: adj. 有节奏的；有韵律的；
words.ex: The children danced to the rhythmic beat.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们随着有节奏的节拍跳舞。
words.en: A rhythmic sound or movement has a clear and regular pattern that is repeated.

words.tr: adj. 刻板的；坚硬的；严格的；
words.ex: He has a rigid attitude toward rules.
words.ex_cn: 他对规则的态度很刻板。
words.en: not able to be changed or adapted; not able to be bent or moved; stiff

words.tr: adj. 充满烟的；冒烟的；烟状的；有烟味的；
words.ex: The room was smoky after the fire.
words.ex_cn: 火灾后，房间里充满了烟。
words.en: If a place is smoky, it is full of smoke or has a lot of smoke in it.

words.ex: The snowy mountains look beautiful in winter.
words.ex_cn: 多雪的山在冬天看起来很美。
words.en: Covered with snow; resembling snow in whiteness or texture.

words.ex: The solar panel collects energy from the sun.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能板从太阳收集能量。
words.en: Solar means relating to the sun or using the energy from the sun to produce electricity.

words.ex: The stony path made walking difficult.
words.ex_cn: 这条多石的小路让行走变得困难。
words.en: Something that is stony is covered with stones or contains a lot of stones. It can also describe someone who is unfriendly or unemotional.

words.tr: adj. 发声的；嗓音的；直言不讳的；
words.ex: He made a vocal sound to get attention.
words.ex_cn: 他发出声音来引起注意。
words.en: If you are vocal about something, you express your opinions or feelings about it in a strong and public way.

words.ex: She wore a woolen scarf in winter.
words.ex_cn: 她在冬天戴了一条羊毛围巾。
words.en: Made of wool; relating to wool.

chapters.name: Level 6 形容词 性别•倾向

words.tr: adj. 易接近的；可使用的；简单易懂的；可进入的；
words.ex: The park is accessible by bus.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园乘公交车可达。
words.en: If a place or building is accessible to people, it is easy for them to reach it or get into it. If an object is accessible, it is easy to reach.

words.ex: Her courage in facing danger is admirable.
words.ex_cn: 她在面对危险时表现出的勇气令人钦佩。
words.en: If you say that something is admirable, you mean that you approve of it or respect it.

words.ex: God is almighty and can do anything.
words.ex_cn: 上帝是全能的，能做任何事。
words.en: The Almighty is used to refer to God. It can also describe something that has very great power or influence.

words.tr: v. 应用；申请；适用；“apply”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 应用的；实用的；
words.ex: He applied the new method to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他应用了这个新方法来解决问题。
words.en: Applied means relating to or put to practical use, especially in a particular field.

words.tr: adj. 有效率的；认真的；有条理的
words.ex: She gave a businesslike reply to the question.
words.ex_cn: 她对这个问题给出了一个高效的回答。
words.en: If you describe someone's approach as businesslike, you mean that they deal with things in an efficient way without wasting time.

words.ex: The weather is changeable in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天的天气是多变的。
words.en: If something is changeable, it can be changed or it changes often.

words.tr:
adj. 集体的；
n. 集体；
words.ex: The collective decision was made by all members.
words.ex_cn: 这个集体决定是由所有成员做出的。
words.en: done or shared by all members of a group of people

words.tr: adj. 组合的；结合的； v. 组合；结合；“combine”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The combined effort of both teams won the game.
words.ex_cn: 两个团队的联合努力赢得了比赛。
words.en: Made by joining two or more things or people together.

words.ex: He is a competent teacher who helps students easily.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有能力的老师，能轻松帮助学生。
words.en: If you are competent to do something, you have the skills, abilities, or experience necessary to do it well.

words.ex: He gave a constructive comment on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 他对我的论文给出了建设性的评论。
words.en: If something is constructive, it is useful and intended to help or improve something.

words.tr: adj. 欧洲大陆的；大陆的；
words.ex: He prefers continental breakfast with bread and coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他更喜欢欧洲大陆式的早餐，有面包和咖啡。
words.en: Continental is used to describe something that relates to or is characteristic of a continent, especially the mainland of Europe as distinct from the British Isles.

words.ex: He speaks in a conversational tone with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友说话时用会话式的语调。
words.en: Relating to or in the style of a conversation; informal and friendly.

words.tr: adj. 令人信服的；有说服力的； v. 说服；“convince”的现在分词；
words.ex: His argument was convincing.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点令人信服。
words.en: A convincing argument, evidence, or person is one that makes you believe that something is true or right.

words.tr: adj. 专注的；专用的；献身的； v. 奉献；“dedicate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is dedicated to his studies.
words.ex_cn: 他专注于学习。
words.en: If you say that someone is dedicated to something, you approve of the fact that they have committed to it and are willing to give a lot of time and energy to it.

words.ex: He took a defensive position to protect the goal.
words.ex_cn: 他采取了防守姿势来保护球门。
words.en: If someone is defensive, they are behaving in a way that shows they are anxious or angry because they feel that they are being criticized.

words.tr:
adj. 深思熟虑的；故意的；
v. 深思熟虑；
words.ex: He made a deliberate choice to quit his job.
words.ex_cn: 他深思熟虑后决定辞去工作。
words.en: If you do something that is deliberate, you planned or decided to do it beforehand, and so it happens on purpose rather than by chance.

words.tr: v. 投入；献身；“devote”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 全心全意的；投入的；
words.ex: He devoted all his time to helping his students.
words.ex_cn: 他把所有时间都投入到了帮助学生上。
words.en: If you are devoted to something, you care about it a lot and are very enthusiastic about it.

words.ex: This painting has a distinctive style.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画有独特的风格。
words.en: Something that is distinctive has a special quality or feature which makes it easily recognizable and different from other things of the same type.

words.tr: adj. 不同的；多种多样的；
words.ex: The class has diverse students from many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级有来自许多国家的不同学生。
words.en: If a group or range of things is diverse, it is made up of a wide variety of things.

words.tr:
n. 纪录片；
adj. 文书的；
words.ex: We watched a documentary about pandas last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚看了一部关于熊猫的纪录片。
words.en: A documentary is a film or television or radio programme that gives factual information about a particular subject.

words.tr:
adj. 精心制作的；详尽的；
v. 精心制作；详尽阐述；
words.ex: She wore an elaborate dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件精心制作的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: To elaborate means to add more details to something that has already been said or written, making it more complex or detailed. As an adjective, it describes something that is very complex and detailed.

words.tr: adj. 有活力的；精力旺盛的；
words.ex: The energetic boy ran around the park all afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 这个有活力的男孩整个下午都在公园里跑来跑去。
words.en: Someone who is energetic is very active and does not tire easily.

words.tr: adj. 永久的；永恒的；经久不变的
words.ex: The love between them is everlasting.
words.ex_cn: 他们之间的爱是永恒的。
words.en: Something that is everlasting lasts forever or for a very long time.

words.tr: adj. 卓越的；杰出的；罕见的；特别的；
words.ex: She is an exceptional student who always gets top grades.
words.ex_cn: 她是一名卓越的学生，总是取得最高分。
words.en: An exceptional person or thing has some unusual quality or ability that makes them different from others.

words.tr:
adj. 爆炸的；
n. 炸药；
words.ex: The explosive material was handled with care.
words.ex_cn: 爆炸性材料被小心地处理。
words.en: An explosive substance is capable of causing an explosion. It can also refer to something that is likely to cause an outburst or a sudden increase in activity or emotion.

words.ex: The faraway village is hard to reach.
words.ex_cn: 那个遥远的村庄很难到达。
words.en: A faraway place is a long distance away from where you are.

words.tr:
adj. 防火的；耐火的
v. 使防火
words.ex: The building was constructed with fireproof materials.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑是用防火材料建造的。
words.en: Something that is fireproof is made of materials that do not burn easily and is therefore difficult to damage or destroy with fire.

words.tr: v. 守卫；“guard”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 谨慎的；有保留的；警戒着的；
words.ex: The soldiers guarded the gate all night.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们整晚守卫着大门。
words.en: If you are guarded, you are careful not to show your feelings or give away information.

words.tr:
adj. 有生理缺陷的；残疾的；弱智的
v. 妨碍；使不利；“handicap”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The school made the playground accessible for handicapped children.
words.ex_cn: 学校让操场方便残障儿童使用。
words.en: A handicapped person has a physical or mental disability.

words.ex: Legends say that some heroes are immortal.
words.ex_cn: 传说有些英雄是不死的。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as immortal, you mean that they are so famous or popular that they will be remembered for a very long time.

words.ex: He is incapable of solving simple math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他无法解决简单的数学问题。
words.en: If someone is incapable of doing something, they are unable to do it.

words.ex: The answer is incorrect.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案是不正确的。
words.en: If something is incorrect, it is not accurate or true.

words.tr: adj. 传染性的；有感染力的；
words.ex: The virus is infectious and spreads quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这种病毒具有传染性，传播迅速。
words.en: An infectious disease can be passed from one person to another, especially through the air they breathe.

words.tr: adj. 了解情况的； v. 通知；告知；“inform”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is an informed voter who reads the news daily.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个了解情况的选民，每天阅读新闻。
words.en: If someone is informed, they know a lot about a particular subject or situation.

words.tr: adj. 坚持的；迫切要求的；持续的
words.ex: He is insistent about finishing his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他坚持要完成作业。
words.en: If someone is insistent, they keep demanding something and refuse to accept any opposition or excuses.

words.tr: adj. 有帮助的；乐器的；仪器的；
words.ex: Her advice was instrumental in helping me pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 她的建议对帮助我通过考试很有帮助。
words.en: If someone or something is instrumental in a process, plan, or system, they are one of the most important influences in causing it to happen.

words.tr: adj. 打算中的；有意的； v. 打算；“intend”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The intended plan was to go hiking.
words.ex_cn: 打算中的计划是去徒步旅行。
words.en: If something is intended for a particular purpose, it has been planned to fulfill that purpose.

words.ex: The shape has irregular sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个形状的边是不规则的。
words.en: Something that is irregular does not follow the expected pattern, plan, or method; it is not regular.

words.tr: adj. 持久的；恒久的； v. 持续；“last”的现在分词；
words.ex: The friendship between them is lasting.
words.ex_cn: 他们之间的友谊是持久的。
words.en: Something that is lasting continues to exist or have an effect for a very long time.

words.ex: He walked alone in the lone park.
words.ex_cn: 他独自走在空无一人的公园里。
words.en: If you talk about a lone person or thing, you mean that they are alone.

words.ex: It was her maiden flight on a plane.
words.ex_cn: 这是她第一次坐飞机。
words.en: A maiden is a young girl or woman who is not married.

words.tr: adj. 有男子气概的；阳刚的；
words.ex: He showed manly courage during the crisis.
words.ex_cn: 他在危机中表现出了男子气概。
words.en: If you describe a man's behaviour or appearance as manly, you mean that it has qualities which are considered typical of a man, such as strength or courage.

words.tr: adj. 短暂的；瞬间的；刹那间的
words.ex: The light made a momentary flash.
words.ex_cn: 灯光闪了一下，但只持续了一瞬间。
words.en: lasting for a very short time

words.tr:
n. 凡人
adj. 致命的；终有一死的
words.ex: All mortal beings must die someday.
words.ex_cn: 所有凡人都终有一死。
words.en: If you refer to the fact that people are mortal, you mean that they have to die and cannot live forever.

words.tr: adj. 可选择的；非强制的；
words.ex: The field trip is optional.
words.ex_cn: 这次郊游是可选的。
words.en: If something is optional, you can choose whether or not you do it or have it.

words.ex: The garden has ornamental flowers.
words.ex_cn: 这个花园里有装饰性的花卉。
words.en: Something that is ornamental is intended to be attractive and is not necessary or useful.

words.tr: v. 归功于；“owe”的现在分词；
words.ex: The team's success is owing to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 团队的成功归功于努力工作。
words.en: If you owe money, you have to pay it back because you have borrowed it or because you have bought something and have not yet paid for it.

words.tr: adj. 一文不名的；穷困的；
words.ex: He was penniless after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后一文不名。
words.en: If someone is penniless, they have no money at all.

words.ex: He made a persistent effort to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 他持续努力学习英语。
words.en: Continuing firmly or obstinately in a course of action in spite of difficulty or opposition.

words.ex: He did a preliminary test before the main experiment.
words.ex_cn: 他在主要实验之前做了一个初步测试。
words.en: Preliminary means something that is done or happens before the main part or event, especially as an introduction or preparation.

words.ex: He became reflective after reading the old letter.
words.ex_cn: 他读完那封旧信后变得沉思起来。
words.en: If you are reflective, you are thinking deeply about something.

words.tr: adj. 使人精神焕发的； v. “refresh”的现在分词；
words.ex: The cool breeze was refreshing after the hot walk.
words.ex_cn: 在炎热的散步之后，凉爽的微风使人精神焕发。
words.en: Something that is refreshing is pleasantly different and interesting.

words.ex: This information is relevant to our project.
words.ex_cn: 这些信息与我们的项目相关。
words.en: Something that is relevant to a situation or person is important or significant in that situation or to that person.

words.ex: He lives in a residential area near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一个住宅区。
words.en: Relating to or suitable for residence.

words.tr: adj. 尊重人的；表示敬意的
words.ex: He is always respectful to his teachers.
words.ex_cn: 他总是对老师很尊敬。
words.en: If you are respectful, you show respect for someone.

words.ex: He is a salaried employee with a fixed monthly income.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名领薪水的雇员，有固定的月收入。
words.en: Receiving a salary; employed for a salary.

words.ex: He bought a secondhand bike for $50.
words.ex_cn: 他花50美元买了一辆二手自行车。
words.en: Something that is secondhand is not new and has been owned by someone else before.

words.ex: He had a sleepless night because of the noise.
words.ex_cn: 因为噪音，他彻夜未眠。
words.en: If you are sleepless, you are unable to sleep.

words.tr: adj. 独自的；单独的；孤寂的；
words.ex: He lives in a solitary house far from the town.
words.ex_cn: 他住在离城镇很远的独自一人的房子里。
words.en: A solitary person or thing is the only one in a place.

words.ex: He wears sporty clothes to run every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上穿运动服去跑步。
words.en: Someone or something that is sporty looks suitable for sport or is interested in sport.

words.ex: The bridge has a strong structural design.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥有坚固的结构设计。
words.en: Relating to the arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex.

words.ex: He won three successive championships.
words.ex_cn: 他连续赢得了三届冠军。
words.en: Following one after the other without interruption.

words.ex: He follows a systematic approach to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种系统的方法来解决数学问题。
words.en: A systematic approach or method is one that is done according to a fixed plan, in a thorough and efficient way.

words.tr: adj. 引起疲劳的；累人的； v. “tire”的现在分词；
words.ex: The long walk was tiring.
words.ex_cn: 这次长时间的散步让人感到疲惫。
words.en: If you describe something as tiring, you mean that it makes you tired so that you want to rest or sleep.

words.tr: adj. 令人烦恼的；讨厌的；
words.ex: The noisy neighbors are troublesome.
words.ex_cn: 那些吵闹的邻居令人烦恼。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as troublesome, you mean that they cause you a lot of problems or worries.

words.ex: He is truthful when he speaks about his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 当他谈论自己的错误时，他是诚实的。
words.en: If someone is truthful, they tell the truth and do not lie.

words.ex: The rain was unavoidable during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨期间，下雨是不可避免的。
words.en: If something is unavoidable, it cannot be avoided or prevented.

words.ex: His talent is undoubted.
words.ex_cn: 他的才华是无疑的。
words.en: If you describe something as undoubted, you mean that it is definitely true or exists and cannot be doubted.

words.ex: He is an unmarried man who lives alone.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个独居的未婚男子。
words.en: Not married; single.

words.ex: The movie showed an unnatural movement of the trees.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了树木不合自然规律的运动。
words.en: If you describe something as unnatural, you mean that it is not normal or not what you usually expect, especially in a way that is unpleasant or worrying.

words.tr: adj. 看不见的；未被发现的；即席的
words.ex: The unseen danger scared the children.
words.ex_cn: 那看不见的危险吓到了孩子们。
words.en: If something is unseen, it is not seen or noticed by anyone.

words.tr: adj. 不利己的；不谋私利的
words.ex: She is unselfish and helps others every day.
words.ex_cn: 她很无私，每天都会帮助别人。
words.en: If you describe someone as unselfish, you mean that they consider other people's wishes, feelings, or needs more than their own.

words.ex: The job position is still vacant.
words.ex_cn: 这个职位仍然空缺。
words.en: If something is vacant, it is not being used by anyone.

words.ex: This coupon is valid until next month.
words.ex_cn: 这张优惠券到下个月都有效。
words.en: If something such as a document or agreement is valid, it is legally acceptable or officially recognized.

words.tr: adj. 各种各样的； v. 改变；变化；使多样化；“vary”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The market sells varied fruits and vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 这个市场出售各种各样的水果和蔬菜。
words.en: If something is varied, it consists of things which are different from each other.

words.tr: adj. 精力充沛的；茂盛的；
words.ex: He is a vigorous man who runs every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个精力充沛的人，每天早上都跑步。
words.en: A vigorous person does things with great energy and enthusiasm. A vigorous campaign or activity is done with great energy and enthusiasm.

words.tr: adj. 虚拟的；几乎的；实际上的；事实上的；
words.ex: He played a virtual game on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他在电脑上玩了一个虚拟游戏。
words.en: If you describe something as virtual, you mean that it is so nearly true that for most purposes it can be regarded as true.

words.ex: It is wasteful to leave the lights on all day.
words.ex_cn: 整天开着灯是浪费的。
words.en: If you describe something as wasteful, you disapprove of it because it uses too much of something valuable, such as time, money, or energy.

words.ex: The watchful mother kept her eyes on the child.
words.ex_cn: 这位警惕的母亲一直盯着孩子。
words.en: If someone is watchful, they are careful to look for any danger or trouble.

words.ex: This jacket is waterproof.
words.ex_cn: 这件夹克是防水的。
words.en: Something that is waterproof does not let water pass through it.

words.ex: He gave up worldly pleasures to live a simple life.
words.ex_cn: 他放弃了世俗的享乐，过着简朴的生活。
words.en: Worldly means relating to the world and the practical matters of life, rather than to spiritual or religious matters.

chapters.name: Level 6 形容词 政治•经济

words.ex: The administrative office handles school records.
words.ex_cn: 行政办公室负责管理学校档案。
words.en: Relating to the management of a company, organization, or institution.

words.tr: v. 竞争；比赛；“compete”的现在分词； adj. 相互矛盾的；
words.ex: Two companies are competing for the same customers.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司正在为相同的客户竞争。
words.en: If one company or country competes with another, it tries to get people to buy its goods or services rather than those of the other company or country.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet is compulsory for cyclists.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车时戴头盔是必须的。
words.en: If something is compulsory, you must do it because of a rule or law.

words.tr: adj. 依…而定的；附带条件的；
words.ex: The prize is conditional on winning the game.
words.ex_cn: 这个奖品取决于是否赢得比赛。
words.en: A conditional action or agreement depends on something else happening or being done.

words.ex: The hospital is an institutional building.
words.ex_cn: 这家医院是一座大型机构的建筑。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of an institution, especially a large organization or public body.

words.ex: The monetary policy affects prices.
words.ex_cn: 货币政策影响价格。
words.en: Monetary means relating to money, especially the total amount of money in a country.

words.ex: He works on a naval ship.
words.ex_cn: 他在一艘军舰上工作。
words.en: Naval means relating to the navy, especially to ships that are used in war.

words.ex: The parliamentary debate lasted all night.
words.ex_cn: 议会辩论持续了一整夜。
words.en: Relating to, enacted by, or suitable for a parliament.

words.tr: adj. 热门话题的；时事问题的；
words.ex: This article is about a topical issue in the news.
words.ex_cn: 这篇文章是关于新闻中的一个热门话题。
words.en: Relating to or dealing with topics of current interest or relevance.

words.tr:
adj. 不带武器的；非武装的
v. 缴械；放下武器；“unarm”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The man was unarmed when the police arrived.
words.ex_cn: 警察到达时，那个人没有携带武器。
words.en: Not equipped with or carrying weapons.

words.ex: This is a good example of teamwork.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个团队合作的好例子。
words.en: An example is a particular instance of something that is representative of a group or used to illustrate a point.

words.tr: adj. 刺痛的； v. 咬；“bite”的现在分词；
words.ex: The biting wind made her shiver.
words.ex_cn: 刺骨的寒风让她颤抖。
words.en: If you describe a remark as biting, you mean that it was strongly critical, often sarcastically so.

words.tr: adj. 可比较的；比得上的；类似的；
words.ex: The prices of these two phones are comparable.
words.ex_cn: 这两部手机的价格是可比较的。
words.en: Something that is comparable to something else is similar in size, amount, or quality.

words.ex: This is a comparative study of two languages.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个关于两种语言的比较研究。
words.en: You use comparative to show that you are judging something against a previous or different situation. For example, if you say that something is comparative luxury, you mean that it is luxurious compared to something else.

words.ex: The continual rain made the road very muddy.
words.ex_cn: 不停的雨让道路变得非常泥泞。
words.en: Something that is continual happens repeatedly over a period of time.

words.ex: The new phone is too costly for me.
words.ex_cn: 这部新手机对我来说太贵了。
words.en: If you say that something is costly, you mean that it costs a lot of money, often more than you would want to pay.

words.tr: adj. 无数的；多的；数不清的；
words.ex: There are countless stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中有无数颗星星。
words.en: Too numerous to count.

words.tr:
n. 等价物；
adj. 相等的；等价的；
words.ex: The dollar is the equivalent of ten yuan.
words.ex_cn: 美元是十元的等价物。
words.en: If one amount or value is the equivalent of another, they are the same.

words.ex: He is still immature and often cries when upset.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然不成熟，生气时经常哭。
words.en: If you describe someone as immature, you are criticizing them because they do not behave in a sensible or responsible way, or because they have not developed emotionally or mentally to the level that is normal for their age.

words.ex: The universe may be infinite.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙可能是无限的。
words.en: If you describe something as infinite, you are emphasizing that it is extremely great in amount or degree.

words.ex: He is an intermediate student in English.
words.ex_cn: 他是英语的中级学生。
words.en: An intermediate stage, level, or position is one that occurs between two other stages, levels, or positions.

words.ex: He is overweight because he eats too much junk food.
words.ex_cn: 他超重是因为吃太多垃圾食品。
words.en: If someone is overweight, they weigh more than is considered healthy or attractive.

words.ex: There are plentiful apples in the basket.
words.ex_cn: 篮子里有丰富的苹果。
words.en: If something is plentiful, there is a lot of it available.

words.ex: The bus stops at the terminal at 9 PM.
words.ex_cn: 公交车晚上9点到达终点站。
words.en: A terminal is a place where vehicles, passengers, or goods begin or end a journey. It can also refer to a computer device at which a user enters data or commands.

words.ex: The earthquake caused tremendous damage.
words.ex_cn: 地震造成了巨大的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as tremendous, you mean that they are very great in amount, extent, or intensity.

words.tr: adj. 无限制的；无限量的；
words.ex: He has unlimited access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 他可以无限制地使用图书馆。
words.en: If something is unlimited, there is no limit to it.

words.ex: He felt unworthy of the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得自己不配得到这个奖。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is unworthy of something, you mean that they do not deserve it.

words.ex: He showed the utmost care when handling the fragile glass.
words.ex_cn: 他在处理易碎的玻璃时表现出了最大的小心。
words.en: The greatest or highest degree of something.

words.tr: adj. 无价值的；不值钱的；微不足道的
words.ex: The old toy is valueless now.
words.ex_cn: 这个旧玩具现在没有价值。
words.en: Having no value; worthless.

words.ex: The old toy is worthless now.
words.ex_cn: 这个旧玩具现在毫无价值。
words.en: If something is worthless, it has no use or value.

words.ex: It is worthwhile to learn a new language.
words.ex_cn: 学习一门新语言是值得的。
words.en: If something is worthwhile, it is enjoyable or useful enough to make the effort or money spent on it seem reasonable.

words.ex: He walked alongside the river.
words.ex_cn: 他沿着河边走。
words.en: If one thing is alongside another thing, the first thing is next to the second.

words.ex: He walked sideways to avoid the puddle.
words.ex_cn: 他斜着走以避开水坑。
words.en: Moving or directed toward one side.

words.ex: This room is comparatively small.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间相对较小。
words.en: In comparison with something else, especially something similar; relatively.

words.tr: adv. 优美地；微妙地；精致地
words.ex: She delicately placed the vase on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她小心翼翼地把花瓶放在桌子上。
words.en: In a manner that is very careful not to cause harm or damage; with great attention to detail.

words.tr: adv. 不诚实地；不正直地
words.ex: He obtained the money dishonestly.
words.ex_cn: 他不诚实地获得了这笔钱。
words.en: In a manner that is not honest; deceitfully.

words.ex: The movie was enormously popular.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极度受欢迎。
words.en: To a very great degree or extent; extremely.

words.ex: She ate the freshly baked bread.
words.ex_cn: 她吃了刚烤好的面包。
words.en: Recently; just now.

words.tr: adv. 适度地；不过分地；有节制地；
words.ex: He eats moderately to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他适度饮食以保持健康。
words.en: In a manner that is neither too much nor too little; to a moderate extent.

words.tr: adv. 谦虚地；谨慎地；适度地
words.ex: She modestly accepted the award.
words.ex_cn: 她谦虚地接受了奖项。
words.en: In a way that is not excessive or extreme; with modesty.

words.ex: The door is partially open.
words.ex_cn: 门部分开着。
words.en: To a limited degree or in a limited manner; not completely.

words.ex: Please tell me beforehand if you can't come.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不能来，请提前告诉我。
words.en: If you do something beforehand, you do it earlier than a particular event.

words.tr: adv. 随意地；偶然地；漫不经心地
words.ex: He casually waved at his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他随意地向朋友挥了挥手。
words.en: In a way that suggests a lack of concern or seriousness.

words.tr: adv. 跟经济有关地；经济地；
words.ex: The country is developing economically.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在经济上发展。
words.en: In a way that relates to economics or finance; in a way that uses no more of something than is necessary.

words.tr: adv. 永远地；永恒地；总是；不断地
words.ex: He loves her eternally.
words.ex_cn: 他永远爱她。
words.en: If something lasts eternally, it lasts forever.

words.ex: He likes reading, and furthermore, he writes stories too.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读，而且他还写故事。
words.en: In addition to what has been said; moreover.

words.ex: It rained all day, hence the game was canceled.
words.ex_cn: 下了一整天的雨，因此比赛被取消了。
words.en: You use hence to indicate that the statement you are about to make is a consequence of what you have just said.

words.ex: Importantly, he finished his homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 重要的是，他按时完成了作业。
words.en: used to emphasize that something is important

words.ex: It was raining, nonetheless, we went for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 天下着雨，尽管如此，我们还是去散步了。
words.en: Nonetheless is used to indicate that something is true or happens in spite of what has just been said.

words.ex: This song is popularly played on the radio.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌普遍地在收音机里播放。
words.en: If something is popularly known as a particular thing, most people know it by that name.

words.ex: This rule is universally accepted.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则被普遍接受。
words.en: In a way that is done or shared by all people or things in the world or in a particular group.

words.ex: He spoke quietly lest he wake the baby.
words.ex_cn: 他低声说话，以免吵醒婴儿。
words.en: If you do something lest something unpleasant should happen, you do it to try to prevent the unpleasant thing from happening.

words.tr: v. 提供；供应；“provide”的过去式和过去分词； conj. 如果；假如；在…条件下；
words.ex: The school provides free lunch to students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费午餐。
words.en: If a particular condition is true or if a particular event happens, then another condition will be true or another event will happen.

words.tr: v. 提供；供应；“provide”的现在分词； conj. 如果；假如；在…条件下；
words.ex: The school is providing free lunches to students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费午餐。
words.en: Used to say that something will happen only if a particular condition is met.

words.ex: He likes coffee, whereas she prefers tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡，然而她更喜欢茶。
words.en: You use whereas to introduce a comment which contrasts with what is said in the main clause.

words.ex: Aha! I found my keys!
words.ex_cn: 啊哈！我找到我的钥匙了！
words.en: An exclamation expressing surprise, triumph, or satisfaction.

words.tr: int. 哎呀！ （表示悲伤、恐惧）；
words.ex: Alas, the little dog was lost in the storm.
words.ex_cn: 哎呀，小狗在风暴中走丢了。
words.en: used to express sadness or disappointment
